summary: Phase 3 testing complete for ProDelivery Bacău platform. All features verified: 1) Backend schedule system with driver hour restrictions (10:00-22:00), 2) Admin can set night hours (22:00-02:00), 3) Orders have zone field (Zona 1-4), 4) Admin summary returns orders_by_zone per driver, 5) ACCEPT button works directly without dialog, 6) PICKUP/DELIVER show confirmation dialog.

issues: React hydration warnings in console due to span elements inside table tr/td/th - cosmetic only, not affecting functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React hydration warnings in table components (AdminScheduleView.jsx, DriverSchedule.jsx) - span elements wrapping tr/td/th. This is likely from React DevTools instrumentation and not a code issue.

seed_orders_with_zone.details: POST /api/seed creates orders with zone field (Zona 1-4)

seed_delivered_orders_with_driver.details: POST /api/seed creates DELIVERED orders with driver_id and driver_name

scheduling_window_endpoint.details: GET /api/schedules/scheduling-window returns is_open boolean, opens_at, closes_at

driver_rejects_night_hours.details: POST /api/schedules with source=driver returns 400 for hours outside 10:00-22:00

admin_schedule_preserves_added_by.details: Schedule slots preserve added_by field ('driver' or 'admin')

admin_program_tab_zone_badges.details: Admin Program tab shows zone badges (Zona 1-4) with MapPin icons on driver cards

admin_edit_dialog_night_hours.details: Admin edit dialog shows hours 10:00-02:00 with moon icon for night hours

driver_schedule_hours_range.details: Driver schedule shows 10:00-22:00 editable, 22:00-02:00 read-only with lock icons

driver_schedule_window_status.details: Driver schedule shows scheduling window status message

driver_accept_no_dialog.details: ACCEPT button works directly without confirmation dialog

driver_pickup_with_dialog.details: PICKUP button shows confirmation dialog 'Confirmați că ați ridicat comanda de la restaurant?'

driver_deliver_with_dialog.details: DELIVER button shows confirmation dialog 'Confirmați că ați livrat comanda clientului?'

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed creates 100 orders (40 DELIVERED with driver assignments), 5 drivers, 5 restaurants

mocked_apis.zone_assignment: Zone assigned based on restaurant_id mapping (temporary until Task 2.2)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features fully implemented. Schedule system has driver hour restrictions (10:00-22:00 editable, 22:00-02:00 read-only). Admin can set all hours 10:00-02:00. Scheduling window opens Sunday 22:00 - Monday 10:00 (currently closed based on server time). Orders have zone field. Admin summary endpoint returns orders_by_zone. ACCEPT button is direct, PICKUP/DELIVER require confirmation. All 14 backend tests pass. All UI features verified via Playwright.
